name: P13_flatmate_onboarding
role: System message of the profile agent (n8n AI Agent node): build a person's flatmate profile by chatting, two questions at a time, then propose the answers with the propose_profile tool; the person confirms on the page before anything is saved (D-115). Adapted from the onboarding agent of Yosr's roommate matching (branch roommate-matching, 2026-10-16): her question order and her rule of at most two questions per message, with this platform's fields instead of her data table (no e-mail, no gender, no dealbreakers list).
